errors.description: No service JWT, or one that does not verify.
errors.name: AuthRequired

errors.description: The body is not `{ subject, subjectType, muted }`, or the subject does not match its type.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: The mute store could not be reached.
errors.name: ServiceUnavailable

muted.description: The desired state. `true` upserts the row; `false` deletes it.

subject.description: The muted resource. For `book` and `contributor`, an at-uri in that collection; for `person`, a DID.

subjectType.description: How `subject` is interpreted and how the feed hides it.

muted.description: The state now stored for the caller.

description: Mute or unmute one book, contributor or person for the caller. Authenticated with an atproto service JWT minted by the caller's own PDS (`aud` this AppView's `did:web`, `lxm` this NSID); the issuer is the only viewer whose rows the call can touch. Idempotent: sending the same `muted` value twice leaves the same state.
